title: 土木数理
subtitle: Mathematics in Civil Engineering
keywords: Civil engineering math 2.Trigonometric functions 3.Exp and log functions 4.Derivatives and integrals 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students can learn basic mathematics used in civil and environmental engineering and acquire the ability to apply them. This course is essential preparation for specialized subjects in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.
advice: In this course, students learn the following contents using textbooks and solve the relevant problems. In order to measure the level of understanding and achievement, students will take ten small tests. Contents: Numbers and variables in equations, primary equations, factorization, second-order equations, shapes and trigonometric ratios, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, logarithmic functions, differentials, integrals, vectors Lectures by external lecturers or video lectures will also be presented.
books: 大学新入生のためのリメディアル数学 (Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: The range of mathematics learned in technical high schools, agricultural high schools, and ordinary courses differs. In this course, students will learn the minimum necessary mathematics to take basic subjects and specialized applied subjects in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering. It is important to review areas and problems that students had not understand coming into the program.

activityGoals.body: Students can solve applied problems using primary equations and second-order equations. [0.25D]
Students can solve applied problems using exponential and logarithmic functions. [0.25D]
Students can solve applied problems using trigonometric functions. [0.25D]
Students can solve applied problems using differentiation and integration. [0.25D]
